title: Version metadata and the 1.0 starting point (D24, D25)
summary: Sets the 1.0 candidate version metadata (branch aliases 1.0.x-dev, root requires ^1.0 and path versions 1.0.0, consumer fixture default 1.0.0) and removes the 0.x history from CHANGELOG, docs, contributor files, composer descriptions and test fixtures; the AI-agent migration instruction moves verbatim to the root UPGRADING.md and docs/upgrade.md leaves the docs site.
why: D23 left version metadata to P4; owner M17 (D24, D25): 1.0 is the starting point and the first CHANGELOG record. Every later P4 artifact (archives stamped with a version, baselines, release notes) must carry 1.0 metadata. Risks: the alias change reaches vendor/ only after composer update of the path packages (owner command) — without it constraints and autoload disagree; deleting docs/upgrade.md breaks MigrationGuideTest and VitePress dead-link checks if a link survives.

include: `packages/core/composer.json`, `packages/filament/composer.json`: `extra.branch-alias.dev-main` → `1.0.x-dev`; root `composer.json`: `require` `axiomasoft/azguard` and `axiomasoft/azguard-filament` → `^1.0`, `repositories[0].options.versions` → `1.0.0` for both, `description` without a version; then the owner runs `composer update axiomasoft/azguard axiomasoft/azguard-filament` (p4-execution#commands)

`CHANGELOG.md`: delete the `[0.7.0]` section and both compare links; `[Unreleased]` becomes the 1.0.0 draft: a short product summary under `### Added` taken from the former 0.7.0 'Added' list (present tense, no history, no 'Fixed' list relative to an earlier version); the final `[1.0.0]` heading and date are P4.7

`RELEASING.md`: 1.0.0 is the first public release, SemVer from 1.0 (a breaking change bumps the major of both packages), examples `1.0.0`/`v1.0.0`, aliases `1.0.x-dev`, `^1.0` root constraints; drop the 0.x sentences (mutation testing sentence names 1.0)

Root `UPGRADING.md`: replace its content with the section `## From 0.7 to 1.0 (instructions for AI agents)` moved verbatim from `docs/upgrade.md` under a one-line intro (instructions for AI agents migrating code written against the unpublished 0.7 development line); delete `docs/upgrade.md`, its sidebar entry in `docs/.vitepress/config.ts`, the README 'Upgrading' link and every other docs link to `/upgrade`; the 'From 0.3 to 0.7.0' section is deleted
README.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, ROADMAP.md, SECURITY.md, `packages/*/README.md`: no 0.x statements (say 1.0 or nothing)

Tests: `tests/Fixtures/Parity/unsupported-0.7.0.json` → `unsupported.json`, `i9-findings-0.7.0.json` → `i9-findings.json` (drop the `baseline` key or make it neutral; `ParityLedger` constants and writer follow); comments of `tests/Feature/Parity/*`, `tests/Fixtures/Parity/*` without 0.7.0; `tests/Regression/README.md`, `tests/Regression/specs/*.md` and `RegressionSpecsTest`: field `Defect in 0.3` → `Original defect` (the probe-file pointer check stays, test titles follow); no assertion is weakened
exclude: The final [1.0.0] CHANGELOG section and release notes text (P4.7)
tests/Arch/LegacyNamesTest.php content (it must name the forbidden legacy names)

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
Order, P4 artifacts, conditional future relocation rules
The upgrade map is only the input list of the AI-agent instruction (D16); nothing to regenerate
Sections to remove and the Added list to reuse
Versioning and cutting-a-release text with 0.7.0 examples
Root file that receives the instruction
Source of the instruction section; deleted afterwards

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
Move the AI-agent instruction text verbatim; only its heading level and the file change.
If `composer update` of the path packages is not permitted to the agent, stop after the composer.json edits and ask the owner to run it before V3.
guidance: Order: composer files → owner `composer update` → consumer fixture → CHANGELOG/RELEASING/UPGRADING/docs → tests. Find every remaining hit with the V2 pattern before committing; `docs/.vitepress/cache` and `docs/public` are not sources. `bin/release-preflight.sh` already accepts any SemVer and needs no change; `bin/test-release-preflight.sh` fixtures may use 0.x example versions only if they are synthetic inputs — rename them to 1.x so the V2 gate passes.

validation.cmd: composer validate --strict --no-check-lock && composer validate --strict packages/core/composer.json && composer validate --strict packages/filament/composer.json

! git grep -nE '(^|[^0-9.])0\.(3|7)(\.[0-9x]+)?([^0-9]|$)' -- README.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASING.md CONTRIBUTING.md DEVELOPMENT.md ROADMAP.md SECURITY.md docs ':!docs/.vitepress/cache' ':!docs/public' composer.json packages bin fixtures tests ':!tests/Arch/LegacyNamesTest.php' ':!tests/Arch/MigrationGuideTest.php'
validation.expect: exit 0 (no 0.x mention outside UPGRADING.md and the two named tests)

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Arch tests/Regression tests/Feature/Parity --fail-on-skipped
test ! -e docs/upgrade.md && grep -q '## From 0.7 to 1.0 (instructions for AI agents)' UPGRADING.md && ! grep -q '/upgrade' docs/.vitepress/config.ts

deliverables: 1.0 version metadata in all manifests and the consumer fixture
Root UPGRADING.md with the AI-agent instruction

result.notes: 1.0 metadata (aliases 1.0.x-dev, root ^1.0, path versions 1.0.0, consumer fixture 1.0.0); CHANGELOG, RELEASING, DEVELOPMENT, CONTRIBUTING, ROADMAP, SECURITY, README, docs and Parity/Regression fixtures free of 0.x; UPGRADING.md holds the AI-agent instruction; docs/upgrade.md removed. composer test: 4797 passed.
